signature: An endless 1980s mall food court lit like daylight under skylights that show only darkness: navy tables around a sunken circle, halls of snack bars from the 1950s to the 1600s, free food that runs out until the weekly restock, and restaurant back doors that let you out somewhere else.

exits.label: Walked out through the perimeter sliding glass doors
exits.source_quote: Sliding glass doors that will bring you to Level 11 , outside of a random restaurant.
exits.hint: The south hall ends at the perimeter: glass doors and orange-white light.

exits.label: Through the rusty steel door into the dark
exits.source_quote: A rusty steel door that leads to Level 6 . Screaming can often be heard behind this door.
exits.hint: The guarded door at the end of the north hall; talk to the guards first.

exits.label: Sucked into a vent and dropped
exits.source_quote: Entering through any vent opening will cause you to be sucked into the vent and dropped into Level 3 .
exits.hint: Low vent grilles in the hall walls; listen for the draught.

exits.label: Stepped into an unnaturally bent wall
exits.source_quote: Finding a wall that is unnaturally bent and entering it can lead you to The Blue Channel .
exits.hint: A stretch of wall in the west hall that is not straight any more.

notes: ADAPTATION: the infinite mall is an authored, seeded slice (a 32 m atrium and four 40-48 m halls, ~40 storefronts) closed by sourced features: the guarded Level 6 door, perimeter glass doors, a room choked with vending machines and a shuttered entrance. The weekly restock is not simulated in real time (stock only runs down). Seeds change the vending-room arrangement, stocks, staff placement and the back-door mapping. Storefront names other than Clippers and Liquorette are generic dressing. The Blue Channel is not built (release boundary). Canon: docs/canon/levels/L006_1.md; CC BY-SA 3.0. Not yet PLAYABLE.
entity_policy: SOURCE_ONLY. Facelings with The 11 Effect (friendly staff) and humans (M.E.G. guards, a Track Mapper, Snackrooms Staff) as static scripted presences. No hostile spawns; the December 2020 infestation is a logged incident shown only through the lockdown notice.
